evidence_sources.key_finding: Flux controller logs show clear dependency error: missing 'database.password' key
Recent commit by SecOps explicitly removed database.password from ConfigMap (secret rotation)
ConfigMap 'app-config-values' was modified 45 seconds before Flux error occurred
Helm chart expects 'database.password' but ConfigMap no longer provides it

correlation_analysis.temporal_proximity: ConfigMap change → Flux reconciliation failure (45s gap, causal)
correlation_analysis.secondary_factors: Secret rotation process incomplete or miscommunicated to Helm chart deployment
